latest.raw:
Given the incredible volume and quality of submissions we've received, we're giving our judging panel a bit more time to properly review everything before announcing winners.

New date: winners will be announced on *December 18*

This is an extension to the judging timeline only and it doesn't change anything about the submission deadline or how to submit. 
We'd simply rather our judges have the time each submission deserves than rush a decision, especially on Track 2, where the panel is reviewing real scientific reasoning behind every proposed drug candidate.

Thank you for your patience, and more importantly, thank you for the incredible work this community has put into this challenge ,  we're genuinely grateful!!
